BiblicalUsage: Zibiah is the mother of King Joash, a woman of Beer-sheba. In 2 Kings 12:1, his mother's name was Zibiah of Beer-sheba. The fuller story is told on the Zibiah, Mother of Joash profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Zibiah belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
